The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S08|Pokémon: Advanced Battle]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Single releases== The ''Advanced Battle'' single DVD releases were released by [[VIZ Media]] in 2006 and 2007, containing the entire season between them. Each volume contains five episodes each with the exception of volumes 9 and 10, which contain six episodes each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Hoenn}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Hoenn}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
